verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a cloud sandbox and agent-hosting platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no first-party bulk-export or account-data export in open formats. Filesystem read APIs are only developer building blocks for building your own export, and the migration skill moves code onto Blaxel, not off it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
